title: Admin panel — orders, delivery & fulfilment — browser test report
area: Admin panel: orders, sub-orders, invoices, refunds, returns, disputes, payments under review, support, warranty, delivery & dispatch, FBN inventory, packaging
summary: Orders were filtered and opened (Oman time), the invoice PDF downloaded, sub-orders moved by state with reason and force-cancelled, a manual refund requested and approved under four-eyes by a second (finance) admin invited through Staff, returns approved/rejected, a dispute thread answered, a payment held under review resolved, a support ticket worked, delivery zones/areas/rates, shipping companies, agent invitations and carrier claims set up, a parcel brought to Packed and assigned on the dispatch board, and the FBN flow run end-to-end: new warehouse, seller inbound plan, arrive, start receiving, receive with damaged units and put-away bin, stock adjustments with audit note, inter-warehouse transfer, removals and pick & pack queues, FBN fees (all 0.00 by owner decision) and packaging supplies. One bug fixed (BT-ADM-002). Re-run of 2026-11-19 after the big development catalogue (5,000 products, about 30,000 offers and 60 sellers per country, new home and category pages, mega menu): the full Playwright suite ran on a fresh production build with E2eSeeder records; {COUNTS}.
environment: Admin panel http://admin.nawy.test:8000 (php artisan serve on :8000, Blade panels; Chromium maps *.nawy.test to 127.0.0.1)
Storefront http://localhost:3000 (next start) — not used by these flows
Dev databases (central noon-plus + nawy_uae …), MAIL_MAILER=log (2FA codes and invitation links read from storage/logs/laravel.log), NAWY_PAYMENTS_DRIVER=fake
Playwright 'areas' project, Desktop Chrome 1280×720, screenshots per step; servers shared with two other QA agents

Each worker signs the e2e admin in once with its own session (password + emailed code), cached in the OS temp dir; the shared e2e/.auth/admin.json is never used or rewritten (a shared session loses flash messages and validation errors to parallel requests)

Run: cd website && E2E_SKIP_SEED=1 npx playwright test --project=areas --no-deps e2e/specs/areas/admin --workers=2 (iteration used e2e/specs/areas/admin/.qa.config.ts, the same config without the global setup that signs the shared customer in and was rate-limited by parallel suites). Report JSON: node e2e/docx/admin-report.mjs <report>; .docx: node e2e/docx/build-docx.mjs e2e/docx/reports/<report>.json

accounts.login: e2e-admin@nawy.test (E2eSeeder), own session per worker, password + emailed 2FA

issues.description: ADM-26 looked for an old placed SoundMax order in a fixed list of 8 dev orders; earlier runs had packed all of them ('no placed SoundMax order left').
issues.fix: ADM-26 creates its own placed cash-on-delivery SoundMax order (NW-AE-E2ED…, e2e customer) for each run and packs that one.

issues.description: Submitting a carrier claim with a parcel number that does not exist returned a bare 404 page (firstOrFail) instead of a form error.
issues.fix: CarrierClaimController@store returns a sub_order_number error ('No parcel with this number in …'). Regression: DeliveryTest 'answers an unknown parcel number … (BT-ADM-002)'.

issues.area: All panels (layout) / customers, classifieds, campaigns, blog, help
issues.description: A refused submit of a compact form (list-row status change with reason, classified reject, platform campaign create, blog post, help article) showed no message at all — the page just reloaded, so it looked like nothing happened. On Customers the status filter also picked up the row form's old 'status' input.
issues.fix: x-layouts.panel now shows an error summary (role=alert) for every field error; pages with their own summary opt out (:error-summary=false); x-ui.select gets :use-old=false for GET filters (customers). Regression: QaWave3JobsAndLifecyclesTest 'suspends and bans customer accounts…' (alert + message + filter value).

issues.description: Actors are shown as 'Admin #37' (statement 'Prepared by', voucher/flash-sale history 'By') instead of the staff member's name.
issues.fix: Resolve the user name in the views.

notes: Re-run of 2026-11-19: results, steps and screenshots are from the full Playwright run after the big catalogue (servers on a fresh production build). Issues BR-xx were found and fixed in this run; older issues are kept for reference.
ADM-26 uses a placed COD SoundMax order created for the run (NW-AE-E2ED…); the old orders NW-AE-1000002/3/5/6 are still used by the other flows.
Orders used: NW-AE-1000002/3/5/6 from 15 Nov (old dev data). ADM-21 and ADM-24 change one-time data (cancel order 3, resolve payment 19): their latest run is the one that performed the action.
Pick & pack shows its empty state: no FBN customer order exists in dev (creating one needs a storefront checkout of an FBN listing, covered by the customer suite).
Warranty claims and agent withdrawals were only listed/filtered: no records in dev.

Totals and steps are the latest recorded run of each flow (e2e/docx/reports/_log/*.jsonl, generated by e2e/docx/admin-report.mjs). Earlier runs that failed were test-script fixes or the bugs listed in 'Issues found', all fixed before the final run.

All data created by these flows carries a run suffix (e.g. 'QA Brand 9abc12x'). Records of today's e2e suites (E2E Store parcels, E2E travel agency, listing 19, E2E Open Souq ads) were not decided or changed.
Backend fixes take effect immediately (PHP/Blade); no website or panel asset rebuild is needed for any fix in this report.
